publicApi.CloudReportMetrics: Existing functions preserved; added state(call), ended(call), customerSeconds(call), queueSeconds(call), queueOutcome(call). stats adds customerSeconds/customerDurationSamples/customerDurationMissing/customerAvgSeconds, queueSamples/queueAbandoned/queueOverflow. adoptedRules: Official startTime controls report date; present raw missing startTime does not use mock ringingAt.
A present official response needs valid endTime to count ended, independent of lagging or completed local event stage.

API317/318/319 bridgeDuration is the reported conversation duration. API318 and automatic customerBridgeDuration is separately counted as customer answer duration. Automatic has no documented human bridgeDuration, so no fabricated human duration.
Official customerNumber controls phone-based identity when raw is present; missing/masked stays unidentified. Platform lead code is a separate business identity handled by the report model.
Inbound firstQueueDuration controls waiting averages, including unanswered queued calls; missing duration is not derived from mock fields or alternate time differences.
Queue outcome only maps exact official 系统应答 plus 队列中放弃/队列中溢出; no inferred queue timeout.
Opaque string cno and flow participants preserve leading zeros. Numeric cno does not silently become a string identifier. API317 query qnos does not constitute returned queue ownership.

Inbound firstCallCno/firstCallQno mean first dialled, not actual/final answered; missing or multi-participant flow leaves whole-call attribution ambiguous. No pairing of cnoFlow/qnoFlow, and no per-segment durations are invented.
Enterprise, source-kind and provided supplier call-identifier mismatches are rejected. Supplier CallID is not equated to local platform callId.

Complete platform history must be explicitly marked attemptHistoryComplete=true before the earliest observed row can be called first; explicit attemptNumber and proven prior same-item calls remain usable. Supplier telRetryRound is exposed separately, not treated as platform attemptNumber.
Versioned positive call-event evidence survives late contradictory unanswered CDR (RG07). Unknown official result cannot be filled from legacy result labels. Explicit agent false stays false (RG12).

Automatic new source uses string customer state/upTime and independently queried endpoint; cno or robot response does not prove human answer. Legacy IVR rows explicitly tagged predictive remain source-tagged API318 for compatibility.

Two-party duration sample/missing counts exclude automatic source and legacy IVR without proven human connection. Applicable calls retain missing/zero distinction; legacy IVR with proven transfer and bridgeDuration remains eligible. Customer durations stay independently aggregated.
